'''Rovan Tresario''' was the founder of [[House Tresario]], a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] loyal to the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] and one of the ten houses that the Guild was comprised of. Tresario was also a high-ranking [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Noble/Legends|aristocrat]] and an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].
